description: This file defines an interface `ConnectionMetricsCounter` used for counting connection metrics such as success and failure events, and retrieving the metric type. It includes method declarations for recording success/failure, resetting counters, and retrieving the metric type.

classes.name: ConnectionMetricsCounter
classes.description: Interface for counting connection metrics, including recording success/failure, resetting, and retrieving metric type.

methods.name: getMetricType
methods.description: Returns the MetricType of this collector.
